summary: Iteration 10 — Manage Subscription (Stripe Customer Portal) verified end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/subscription/portal returns 404 for unknown user and 200 with portal_url starting https://billing.stripe.com/ for the paid test user anon-2392ee4d-9e7c-44f6-8715-7599a3a5053e. Frontend: after setting localStorage.wisdom_user_id to the paid user id, the nav shows data-testid='access-pill-pro' rendered as a <button> containing the Sparkles icon, 'PRO' text, and a trailing Settings gear icon. Clicking it triggers context.expect_page() and opens https://billing.stripe.com/p/session/test_... in a new tab. Regression: clearing localStorage shows access-pill-free (no Pro pill), and clicking it opens the paywall-modal as before. Full pytest regression (7 tests from iteration_9) + 2 new portal tests all pass (9/9).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly rejects portal requests for users without an active subscription (404), preventing abuse.
_ensure_portal_configuration() fallback works — the sandbox account did not previously have a default billing portal config and yet the endpoint returned a valid portal URL on first call.

Frontend: access-pill-pro is now a proper <button> and dispatches window.open with target=_blank + noopener,noreferrer (safe). Loader spinner state exists in code but not observed in test because the API responded < 300 ms; not a bug.
Suggestion (non-blocking): consider aria-label='Manage subscription' on the Pro pill button for screen readers, and disabling the button while the request is in-flight to prevent double-clicks.
seed_data_creation: None — reused paid subscription from iteration_8.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal endpoint: POST /api/subscription/portal {app_user_id,return_url}. Returns 404 without active sub, 200 {portal_url:'https://billing.stripe.com/p/session/test_...'} with active sub. Pro pill (data-testid=access-pill-pro) is a <button>; when clicked calls openBillingPortal() then window.open(url,'_blank'). Use context.expect_page() in Playwright to catch the new tab. Do NOT try to interact inside the Stripe billing portal UI.
